code:
phone: phone.c
	gcc -o phone phone.c

clean:
	rm -f phone
description: This Makefile builds phone from its C source and removes the executable when asked.

steps.description: The phone target depends on phone.c. Its tab-indented command compiles the executable.
The clean target removes the built phone executable.
make builds the first target only when phone.c is newer than phone. make clean runs the separate cleanup target.

title: Build and clean with Make
